intro: A snapshot of how I've been lately.

sections.title: Current Status
items: I briefly worked as a software engineer in Tokyo, but left the role for several reasons. I'm looking for another full stack job in Tokyo.

sections.title: Recent Practices
items: Taking action instead of giving in to anxiety.
Staying focused while working at home. I'm paying more attention to managing my focus than managing my time, and doing one thing at a time.
Leaving room in my life instead of filling every spare moment.
Finding better sources of information and spending less time doomscrolling on social media.
Improving my Japanese and passing the JLPT N1 this December!
Contributing to Apache Kafka with [源來適你](https://github.com/opensource4you/readme).
Reading [Stanford CS329z](https://cs329z.stanford.edu/) with Bohr and friends.
Returning to pen and paper: writing journal entries, notes, and ideas on sticky notes and loose leaf paper, and letting go of my attachment to note taking apps.

sections.title: Recent Satisfactions
items: Getting back into the gym without chasing heavy weights or big goals; first, I'm building a steady routine.
Cooking better meals for myself and starting to cook for other people, too.
Contributing regularly to the [Apache Kafka](https://github.com/apache/kafka) open source project.
Continuing to update my personal site: I added [Stream](/stream) for short posts and spun off [Parker's Dev Blog](https://dev.parkerchang.life) for more software development writing.

sections.title: Recent Frustrations
items: My first software engineering job in Tokyo didn't go well. I hope I can find another one and stay here.
I fulfilled my wish of moving to Japan, but changing countries didn't make all my problems disappear. I have no excuse to avoid them now.
Making choices about the things I want to do and the relationships I want to maintain.

sections.title: Recent Favorites
items: 🍁 The cooler autumn weather. Even with Tokyo's record stretch of rain, Aoba Ward in Kanagawa still gets plenty of sunny days. The commute is the price I pay for good weather.
📖 Book: 一本書終結你的拖延症
🎵 J-Pop: わたしの代わり (Ai Higuchi), 24hours (Chilli Beans), Christmas Eve (milet)
🎨 Manga: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun (I picked it up again after season 4 of the anime and love it), Yomi no Tsugai (I caught up with the manga after the anime ended)
📺 Anime: Draw This, Then Die!, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run
🎬 Movie: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
